mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 76 degrees, though it feels like 83. The moon is in its Third Quarter phase. If you are an early bird, the International Space Station will be visible at 4:24 AM for two minutes, rising in the West Northwest and passing almost directly overhead toward the East Southeast. Tonight will reach a low of 68 degrees, and there is no rain expected overnight.

The City of Verona has announced that phase two of the Aldi development road construction on Highway M begins the week of September 7, which will include traffic shifts and the reopening of the Kwik Trip right turn exit. Additionally, the Military Ridge State Trail paving project is underway, with a full closure between Lincoln and South Franklin Street scheduled from mid-September to mid-November for bridge replacements.

There is plenty to do in our community. Live music is happening today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, the Dane County Farmers Market will be at the Capitol Square, and Paddy Mac's will host their music series. Next week, look forward to yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday, trivia at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company on Monday, and the Verona Downtown Farmers Market on Tuesday.

The Verona Police Department issued a release regarding an arrest made on Friday, September 4. The investigation began on Sunday, August 30, after the school district reported an inappropriate relationship between a teacher and a student that occurred in 2019.
Today's flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. The store is currently open and will remain so until 10:30 PM this evening.
